title: mac-nr: add mac-nr-framed protocol
description:
In [srsRAN Project](https://github.com/srsran/srsRAN_Project), we save MAC-NR PDUs directly to a file using UDP framing, so that we and our users can inspect the pcaps of the 5G connection.
While this works well for most scenarios, I've come across some issues when working with 4x4 MIMO.

The issue is that with such a high number of layers, the size of the MAC PDU can easily surpass 65536 bytes, thus hitting the size limits in the UDP header. Wireshark starts showing the frame as malformed, while it is not.
To avoid this problem, I've added a `mac-nr-framed` dissector, which is basically a copy of the old `mac-lte-framed` dissector. This allows me to correctly inspect the contents of very large PDUs. 

While the MR is simple, I am not too familiar with the wireshark code, so I could have certainly made a mistake somewhere.
Please review with some care.

Also, perhaps there would be some simpler way to circumvent this problem, I'm not really sure.
But I thought that maybe this could be useful for other people too :smile:

That would not solve the max TB length issue reported by Pedro. Let's add the mac-nr-framed dissector (I did not add it initially because I though UDP framing would be sufficient), and it can be called in a WTAP_ENCAP_WIRESHARK_UPPER_PDU format with `EXP_PDU_TAG_DISSECTOR_NAME` set to mac-nr-framed instead of requesting a specific DLT.
A sample trace would be nice.

Let me know if you would like me to capture other settings variations.

[gnb_mac.tar.gz](/uploads/f3062a9ffbfeb3d1aaaa0df2d195a180/gnb_mac.tar.gz)

You will need to set the DLT_USER=157 to `mac-nr-framed`.

I see that https://www.wireshark.org/~martinm/mac_pcap_sample_code.c and https://www.wireshark.org/~martinm/mac_lte_logger.c now return 404 errors.  These were short console programs (under BSD license) that showed how to log frames over UDP or write directly to PCAP for the 'framed' format. I believe at one point I tried and failed to update the latter - an issue I remember was that it didn't open the file with "b" for binary, which meant that anything bigger than the sample program would get unwanted /d line endings every 2k characters or so...

I guess I should create/recreate working examples and link to them from the protocol pages on the wiki.  Though for mac-nr-framed we should steer people towards using WTAP_ENCAP_WIRESHARK_PDU (avoiding the need to configure an unassigned DLT), and (ideally) make it pcapng.  Could these be in-tree (we have code that is "BSD-3-Clause"), or would it be better to create a separate gitlab or github project for these?

Does anyone happen to have a copy of the original mac_pcap_sample_code.c and mac_lte_logger.c ?

IMHO we should not pollute the repository with this kind of things and store them somewhere else.

I do not have a copy of your old programs.

commits_data.title: mac-nr: add mac-nr-framed protocol
commits_data.message:
mac-nr: add mac-nr-framed protocol

This is done so that we can save MAC PDUs to a file without
UDP framing, bypassing UDP's uint16 frame size limitations.
